# Olympost

> Olympost is a done-for-you AI video service. It generates short videos (Reels) for your product, edits them and posts them every day across a network of Instagram accounts that run on real phones. You fill in one brief; you do not shoot, edit, post, research competitors or manage accounts.

## What it does
- Generates short AI videos for your product (models include Seedance), in any language, 4–60 seconds.
- Edits and posts them daily on Instagram accounts that run on real phones; TikTok and YouTube on request.
- Checks every video against Meta policy before posting and learns from every published video.
- Replaces a blocked account right away; if a client leaves, the accounts are handed over to them.
- Gives the client access to the software with every video and all stats.

## How to start
- Volume starts from 1,000 videos a month for your product. Price depends on volume and is set on the call.
- After a 25-minute call we make 3 test videos for your brand, before you pay.
- Launch in 3–7 days. Full refund within 14 days.
- White-label: sell the software under your own brand, for a share of your sales or for a fixed fee.

## Who it is for
E-commerce, clinics, iGaming, apps and games, agencies.
